name: WeRide
sub: Robotaxi & passenger L4; Goods delivery autonomy; Robotaxi consumer services
regions: China; UAE; Saudi Arabia; Singapore; Europe pilots
about: Chinese L4 autonomy company spanning robotaxis, robobuses, robovans and sanitation vehicles, with unusually broad international permits and Gulf deployment.
model: Robotaxi fares; B2B autonomous shuttle / vehicle deployments; platform partnerships
financing: Public (Nasdaq: WRD / HKEX: 0800); $440.5M US IPO and placements (Oct 2024) plus ~$308M Hong Kong dual-primary listing (Nov 2025)
deployment: China city services in Beijing, Suzhou, Guangzhou and Ordos; fully driverless commercial operations in Abu Dhabi, with Dubai and Riyadh scaling under a February 2026 plan with Uber for at least 1,200 robotaxis across the three cities by 2027; Spain's first commercial robotaxi pilot announced for Madrid with Uber and Avomo (June 2026).
metrics: AV fleet over 1,600 vehicles as of 31 October 2025, of which nearly 750 robotaxis; the global robotaxi fleet reached roughly 1,300 by the end of April 2026, about 1,000 of them in China, with average daily orders per vehicle above 17 in Q1. Licensed in eight countries, the broadest regulatory footprint of any operator. Q1 2026 revenue RMB 114.1M, up 57.6% year on year.
signal: Launched fully driverless, fare-charging robotaxi operations in Dubai with Uber and the RTA on 2 April 2026, following a supervised service from December 2025 and an RTA driverless trial permit in February 2026. Abu Dhabi coverage reached about 70% of core areas.

sources.title: WeRide Q1 2026 results: record revenue up 57.6% YoY; Abu Dhabi service covers ~70% of core areas
WeRide and Uber launch fully driverless robotaxi fare-charging operations in Dubai
